def best_average(a: list[int], k: int) -> list[int]:
    from math import gcd

    n = len(a)
    prefix = [0] * (n + 1)
    for i, value in enumerate(a, 1):
        prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1] + value

    hull = []
    head = 0
    best_num = -1
    best_den = 1

    for end in range(k, n + 1):
        x = end - k
        y = prefix[x]

        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x1 = hull[-2]
            x2 = hull[-1]
            if (x2 - x1) * (y - prefix[x2]) > (
                prefix[x2] - prefix[x1]
            ) * (x - x2):
                break
            hull.pop()

        hull.append(x)

        while len(hull) - head >= 2:
            x1 = hull[head]
            x2 = hull[head + 1]
            if (prefix[end] - prefix[x1]) * (end - x2) > (
                prefix[end] - prefix[x2]
            ) * (end - x1):
                break
            head += 1

        start = hull[head]
        num = prefix[end] - prefix[start]
        den = end - start

        if num * best_den > best_num * den:
            best_num = num
            best_den = den

    divisor = gcd(best_num, best_den)
    return [best_num // divisor, best_den // divisor]
